bonuses_some_locked: You have joined the alliance on [DATE] at [TIME]. With that not all bonuses are applying yet. Check below to see which bonuses are not yet active.
bonuses_description: Your alliance provides bonuses for your villages. Donate resources to a bonus to increase the advantage. As bonuses need a big amount of resources, the whole alliance should donate to this cause.
TroopProductionSpeedDescription: Sharing knowledge within your alliance is key to success. With the combined knowledge of how to drill recruits faster, your alliance will have a strong army in offense and defense. Its even the only way to further improve the training time of siege weapons.
CPProductionDescription: Even with so much fighting going on within the world of Travian Artists generate Culture Points. With the help of your alliance, these masters of art will be able to increase your Culture Point production. It will not affect the CP-Gain of Artworks.
SmithyPowerDescription: There are many secrets about how to forge steel even harder, even sharper. Sharing these secrets within your alliance will result in stronger units.
MerchantCapacityDescription: Within an alliance not only military aid is needed, also support with resources to push a village at front line is crucial. The talent of your merchants will allow you to pack more resources on their carts.

TroopProductionSpeedTooltip: This bonus will decrease the time troops will need to be trained in barracks, stable, residence, palace and workshop by [CURRENT_BONUS] percent.

SmithyPowerTooltip: This bonus will increase offensive and defensive strength of your troops in combat by [CURRENT_BONUS] percent.

allianceBonus_headerDescription: Teamwork is the key to success in the world of Travian. Contribute resources to get bonus rewards for the whole alliance and increase the advantage over the others. As bonuses need big amounts of resources, the whole alliance needs to contribute to this cause.
allianceBonus_sitterNotAllowedToContribu: As a sitter you have no permission to contribute resources.
allianceBonus_dailyContributionLimitReac: You have reached your daily contribution limit. Reset in [RESET_COUNTDOWN].
TroopProductionSpeedExtendedDescription: Sharing military insights can be substantial in winning a war. Advancements in siege engine development and well-schooled instructors will increase the size of your army faster.
CPProductionExtendedDescription: For an empire to thrive you need more than just an army. Provide education in human sciences for your people to become pioneers in architecture and village planning. An influential culture will encourage foreign nations to accept your rule.
SmithyPowerExtendedDescription: Throughout history, conflicts were determined by the same principle: You gotta have the bigger stick. Upgraded armor and enhanced weaponry will enable your soldiers to overpower their enemies.
MerchantCapacityExtendedDescription: A battle without resupplies is a battle lost. Packhorses and bigger carts facilitate your merchants to carry more resources to where they are needed most, be it the front or a comrade in need.
